## tf.handshake
Called by the main flow before any paid step. Reads the key's standing (`GET /v1/access/key`), the documents it still lacks for the product (`GET /v1/access/agreements`), accepts them only when the caller consented (`accept_terms: true`, a click-through acceptance recorded under the key's ref), and asks for a top-up quote. Every answer is read into one error contract (coord `gate-errors.cue`).
